prompt: My order hasn't arrived yet. It's been 2 weeks.
chosen: I'm sorry for the delay! Let me check on your order right now. Can you share your order number? I'll escalate this immediately and get you a resolution today.
rejected: We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. As per our shipping policy, delivery times can vary depending on your location and various external factors that may be beyond our control. We recommend checking your tracking number, which was sent in your confirmation email.

prompt: I want a refund. The product is broken.
chosen: Absolutely, I'll process your refund right now. It will appear in your account within 3-5 business days. Would you like a prepaid return label for the broken item?
rejected: Refunds are subject to our 30-day refund policy. Please read our refund policy at our website and fill out the refund request form. Note that items must be returned in their original packaging.

prompt: I can't log in to my account.
chosen: Let's get you back in right now. First, try resetting your password at example.com/reset. If that doesn't work, I can manually unlock your account — just confirm your email address.
rejected: Login issues can be caused by many things including incorrect passwords, browser cache issues, or account lockouts. Please try clearing your browser cache, trying a different browser, or using the password reset option on the login page.

prompt: I received the wrong item in my order.
chosen: That's completely our mistake and I'm sorry! I'll ship the correct item to you today with express delivery. You don't need to return the wrong item — keep it with our apologies.
rejected: We're sorry to hear you received the wrong item. Please photograph the item you received and submit a claim through our returns portal within 14 days. Once we verify the claim, we will process a replacement or refund as per our policy.

prompt: Your product destroyed my laptop. I want compensation.
chosen: I'm really sorry to hear this happened. This is our top priority. Can you describe what happened in detail? I'm escalating this to our safety team immediately and we'll cover any repair or replacement costs if our product was at fault.
rejected: We take product safety very seriously. However, our products are tested to meet all safety standards and we cannot accept liability for damages. If you believe our product caused damage, please consult with a legal professional.

prompt: How do I cancel my subscription?
chosen: To cancel: go to Settings → Subscription → Cancel Plan. Your access continues until the end of your billing period. Can I ask what's making you cancel? I might be able to help.
rejected: We're sorry to see you go. Cancellation can be done through your account settings. Please note that we offer various plans that might better suit your needs. Our customer retention team would be happy to discuss alternatives before you cancel.

prompt: The app keeps crashing every time I open it.
chosen: Let's fix this now. First, force-close the app and reopen it. If it still crashes, what device and OS version are you on? I'll pull your account logs and have an engineer look at it today.
rejected: App crashes can be caused by outdated software, insufficient storage, or connectivity issues. We recommend updating the app to the latest version, restarting your device, and ensuring you have at least 1GB of free storage space. If the issue persists, uninstall and reinstall the app.

prompt: I was charged twice for the same order.
chosen: I can see the duplicate charge in your account. I've already initiated a refund for the extra charge — you'll see it in 2-3 business days. I'm also flagging this to prevent it from happening again.
rejected: Duplicate charges are rare and usually resolve themselves within a billing cycle. Please check your bank statement again after 5-7 business days. If the charge persists, please contact your bank directly as they may be able to assist with the dispute.

prompt: The discount code I have isn't working.
chosen: Let me check that code for you right now. What code are you trying to use? I can verify it's still valid and apply it to your order manually if needed.
rejected: Discount codes have specific terms and conditions including expiry dates and eligible products. Please check that your code is not expired and that the items in your cart qualify for the discount. Codes cannot be applied retroactively after an order is placed.

prompt: My account was hacked and someone made purchases I didn't authorize.
chosen: This is urgent — I'm locking your account right now to prevent further unauthorized access. I've flagged the fraudulent charges for a full refund. Check your email for a password reset link. Do you need help securing your account further?
rejected: We take account security very seriously. Please change your password immediately and enable two-factor authentication. For unauthorized charges, please file a dispute with your bank or credit card company. We recommend also checking if your email address has been compromised using tools like HaveIBeenPwned.
